study type: Cross-sectional study of a defined cohort
outcome: gut microbiota signature (alpha-diversity, beta-diversity, specific species enrichment, functional pathways)
urine metabolomics signature (specific metabolites and metabolic pathways)
cohort: 88 well-characterized participants (ASD children and healthy controls) of the Zhuang ethnic group from Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region in Southern China.
finding: The study identified a typical signature of lower gut microbial alpha-diversity, unique beta-diversity, enriched specific species, and distinct urine metabolomic profiles positively correlated with Arginine/Proline metabolism in ASD children from Southern China compared to healthy controls.
